root_causes: AIRestClient logged the complete upstream moderation HTTP error body, which could echo submitted story or post text.
AIRestClient logged unexpected moderation failures with their exception stack trace, and ContentModerationProviderImpl logged exception text.

failure_first.fixture: A local HTTP server returned 503 with a synthetic user-caption sentinel in the response body.
failure_first.observed_before_fix: The captured Monolith log contained the echoed caption.

failure_first.fixture: The client raised an exception whose message contained a synthetic caption sentinel.
failure_first.observed_after_fix: The provider returns a fail-closed flag and logs only the exception class.

implementation: Moderation HTTP failures log the status code without logging the response body.
Unexpected moderation HTTP-client failures log the exception class without the exception object or message.
The content-moderation adapter logs only the exception class and retains its fail-closed flag behavior.

frontend_headed_browser.api_mode: All /api/v1/** calls were intercepted by local fixtures.

frontend_unmocked_local_probe.reason: The local Monolith rejected the intentionally synthetic unsigned access token, so the protected route redirected to sign-in before the composer loaded.

limitations: No valid local test identity or reachable moderation service was available for an authenticated live FE-to-Monolith publish.
No production moderation service, Mongo persistence, storage upload, or deployed log sink was exercised.
T-11 remains partial; this change narrows one identified moderation log path and does not establish a complete log/response/artifact inventory scan.
